steps.description: 1 Add `_ccgl_self_holder_v`, `_ccgl_race_note_post_v`, `_ccgl_race_note_delete`, `_ccgl_race_note_update`, `_ccgl_race_note_first_v` to plugin.sh; extend `claim_coordinator_claim` to: post the concurrent claim note, re-read the GitHub issue, then read back concurrent claim notes, returning `race_lost: true` for the loser (gh backend only)
2 In `zbuild_claim_acquire`, detect `race_lost: true` in the refused reply and refuse immediately (skip stale-takeover, print concurrent-winner message)
3 Amend ADR-005: add §5 (concurrent claim detection: arbitration note, first-by-created_at-then-id wins, loser updates note to not-started, `race_lost` skip); extend `Enforced by`

specs.DSRACE-1:
After successfully adding the zbuild:claimed label (gh backend), the claim posts a concurrent claim note with the run's holder, then reads back all trusted concurrent claim notes to detect concurrent claimants
  Given: the zbuild:claimed label was just successfully added via the gh backend
  When: the claim posts a "concurrent claim by `<holder>`" note and reads back all trusted concurrent claim notes since the note's own created_at minus the detection window
  Then: the note is posted synchronously before the read-back
  And: all concurrent claim notes from the current label epoch are returned
specs.DSRACE-3:
The losing run updates its concurrent claim note body to "not started"
  Given: the run's concurrent claim note is not the first by created_at (or id)
  When: the run determines it has lost the race
  Then: the run PATCHes its note body to "not started — concurrent claim: `<winner>` was first"
specs.DSRACE-7:
After posting the concurrent claim note (the synchronous holder record, gh backend), the claim reads back the GitHub issue's current state before proceeding with arbitration
  Given: the zbuild:claimed label was added and the concurrent claim note was posted synchronously
  When: the claim reads the GitHub issue's current labels or state
  Then: fresh issue data is obtained from GitHub after the synchronous holder record was written
specs.DSRACE-4:
When zbuild_claim_acquire receives {"acquired": false, "race_lost": true} from the coordinator, _ZBUILD_CLAIM_ACQUIRED is not set and zbuild_claim_release does not remove the zbuild:claimed label
  Given: claim_coordinator_claim returns {"acquired": false, "race_lost": true}
  When: zbuild_claim_acquire processes the response
  Then: _ZBUILD_CLAIM_ACQUIRED is not set
  And: zbuild_claim_release does not remove the zbuild:claimed label
specs.DSRACE-5:
A coordinator response with race_lost: true causes zbuild_claim_acquire to refuse immediately without entering the stale-takeover path, printing a message that names the concurrent winner
  Given: claim_coordinator_claim returns {"acquired": false, "holder": "<winner>", "race_lost": true}
  When: zbuild_claim_acquire processes the response
  Then: the stale-takeover hook is not called
  And: stderr names the concurrent winner as the first claimant
specs.DSRACE-6: ADR-005 §5 tells a reader: after adding the label (gh backend), a note is posted as the holder record, the first note by created_at then id wins, the loser marks its note "not started", and race_lost: true in the refused response skips the stale-takeover path
